passages.title: How a shared invention challenge works
body: Pelnari Components invites employees from any department to propose a practical solution to this quarter's challenge: reducing the effort required to open our reusable delivery cases. A proposal may be a sketch, a short description, or a simple model. [1] Presentation quality will not be scored; the first review asks whether the idea addresses the stated problem.

Proposals selected for a trial will be developed with help from the engineering workshop. The original contributor will remain involved, but workshop staff may suggest changes needed to make a working version. [2] Employees should therefore be willing to discuss and revise their ideas rather than expect the first sketch to become a finished product unchanged.

Trial results will be shared with all contributors after the review. A proposal that does not reach production may still reveal a useful limitation or lead to another approach. [3] The review team will explain those findings instead of announcing only a winning name. Recognition will list the people who made substantial contributions during development, including those who helped test a revised version.

Submit your idea through the internal challenge page by June 14. Do not send confidential information from a previous employer or material owned by another organization. [4] Questions about the case dimensions can be directed to the workshop, which has a sample available for inspection during lunch periods. No department manager's endorsement is required to enter.

passagesKo.title: 공동 발명 과제 운영
body: 펠나리 컴포넌츠는 재사용 배송함을 여는 힘을 줄이는 이번 분기 과제에 모든 부서 직원을 초대합니다. 스케치, 짧은 설명, 간단한 모형을 낼 수 있습니다. [1] 표현 완성도는 채점하지 않으며 첫 검토는 제시된 문제를 해결하는지 봅니다.
시험 대상으로 선정된 제안은 기술 작업장의 도움으로 개발합니다. 원 제안자는 계속 참여하지만 작동하는 제품을 위해 작업장 직원이 변경을 제안할 수 있습니다. [2] 처음 스케치가 그대로 완제품이 되기를 기대하기보다 논의하고 수정할 의향이 있어야 합니다.
검토 뒤 모든 제안자에게 시험 결과를 공유합니다. 생산되지 못한 제안도 유용한 제약이나 다른 접근법을 드러낼 수 있습니다. [3] 검토팀은 수상자 이름만이 아니라 이런 발견을 설명합니다. 수정본 시험을 도운 사람을 포함하여 개발에 실질적으로 기여한 사람을 공로자로 기록합니다.
6월 14일까지 내부 과제 페이지에 제출하십시오. 이전 고용주의 비밀 정보나 타 조직 소유 자료는 보내지 마십시오. [4] 치수 질문은 점심시간에 견본을 볼 수 있는 작업장에 하십시오. 참가에 부서장 추천은 필요 없습니다.

passages.title: When a customer asks us to stop calling
body: Sales staff occasionally receive a request to stop telephone contact while a customer still wants order confirmations by e-mail. Please record the requested channel precisely. A telephone restriction should not be expanded into a blanket ban on all communication unless that is what the customer asks for. [1] Likewise, permission to send an order confirmation does not establish permission for promotional calls.

The customer record now has separate fields for sales calls, promotional e-mails, and messages needed to complete an existing order. When a request arrives, read it carefully and update the relevant fields. If the wording is unclear, ask one concise question through the channel the customer is currently using. [2] Do not guess simply to clear the request from your queue.

Record the customer's words in the private contact note as well as changing the fields. [3] That note helps another employee understand why a restriction was entered, especially if the customer contacts us later about a different matter. Keep the note factual and avoid comments about the customer's attitude.

The sales team will review the updated fields before preparing each call list. Staff should use the current list rather than a copy saved from an earlier campaign. [4] If an incorrect call occurs, notify the team coordinator so that the source of the outdated entry can be identified. Correcting only your personal copy may leave the same problem in other lists.

passagesKo.title: 고객의 전화 중단 요청
body: 영업 직원은 고객이 주문 확인 이메일은 원하지만 전화는 중단해 달라는 요청을 받기도 합니다. 요청한 경로를 정확히 기록하십시오. 고객이 요구하지 않았다면 전화 제한을 모든 연락 금지로 확대하면 안 됩니다. [1] 마찬가지로 주문 확인 발송 허가가 홍보 전화 허가를 뜻하지는 않습니다.
고객 기록에는 영업 전화, 홍보 이메일, 기존 주문 완료에 필요한 메시지를 위한 별도 항목이 생깁니다. 요청을 읽고 관련 항목을 갱신하십시오. 뜻이 불분명하면 고객이 현재 쓰는 경로로 간결한 질문 하나를 하십시오. [2] 대기 목록에서 지우려고 추측하지 마십시오.
항목 변경과 함께 비공개 연락 메모에 고객의 말을 적으십시오. [3] 고객이 나중에 다른 일로 연락할 때 다른 직원이 제한 이유를 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 사실만 적고 고객 태도에 대한 평가는 피하십시오.
영업팀은 통화 목록 작성 전 갱신된 항목을 검토합니다. 이전 캠페인 저장본 대신 현재 목록을 사용하십시오. [4] 잘못 전화했다면 팀 조정 담당자에게 알려 오래된 항목의 출처를 찾아야 합니다. 개인 사본만 고치면 다른 목록에 문제가 남을 수 있습니다.

passagesKo.title: 공동 발표문의 이름 순서
lines: 유통업체와의 공동 발표문은 첫 문장의 회사명 순서만 남았어요. 우리 초안은 우리가 먼저이고 그쪽은 반대예요.

passages.title: Day visits at the Velrani Pet Hotel
body: The Velrani Pet Hotel gives owners a written summary after each trial day. The summary describes meals, rest periods, and the activities the animal joined. Staff record observations rather than assigning a general personality label. An animal that rests quietly on its first visit may behave differently after becoming familiar with the building.

Four activity areas are used during the trial. Area K is an outdoor grass enclosure, Area L is an indoor play space, Area M is a quiet resting area, and Area N is a covered exercise path. Staff move animals between areas individually, and the same animal may use several areas during one visit. Owners receive a timetable showing where their animal spent each part of the day. They can discuss that timetable with the employee who supervised the visit. The hotel does not combine animals from different households during a first trial day. Food brought from home is kept in a labeled container and returned if unused.

passages.title: Pella's trial-day summary
heading: To: Pella's owner
From: Nira Selvo
Subject: Trial-day summary
body: Pella arrived at nine and spent the first hour in Area L with her supervising employee. From ten until eleven she was in Area K. After her meal, she rested in Area M until one thirty. She then spent half an hour in Area N before returning to Area L for the rest of the visit.

She ate most of the food you supplied. The unused portion is in the original labeled container, which we returned with her bag. She approached the employee readily during play but preferred to rest alone after eating. These are observations from today rather than predictions about future visits.

Your next trial booking is for Thursday. Please bring the same bag so we can keep her belongings together. The supervising employee will be available at collection time to discuss today's timetable and answer questions about how the areas are used. We have attached the attendance record for your own files.

Area K는 야외 잔디 울타리, Area L은 실내 놀이 공간, Area M는 조용한 휴식 공간, Area N는 지붕 있는 운동로다. 개별적으로 이동하며 하루 여러 곳을 쓸 수 있다. 보호자는 시간표를 받고 담당자와 논의할 수 있다. 첫 방문에는 다른 가정 동물과 섞지 않는다. 집에서 가져온 사료는 라벨 용기에 보관하고 남으면 돌려준다.

passages.title: Who creates a book jacket?
body: At Nolvari Press, several specialists contribute to a book jacket. An illustrator creates the image, a designer arranges the image and text, a letterer draws any custom title lettering, and a production specialist prepares the final file for printing. One person may perform several roles, but credits identify the actual contribution rather than merely naming a team.

The new travel essay collection, Quiet Crossings, has a jacket produced by four people. Mera Voss supplied the river illustration. Tavin Rel arranged the illustration, title, and author name. Olin Sera drew the title characters by hand. Nela Fenn checked color separations and prepared the print-ready file. The author's own photographs appear inside the book, not on the jacket.

The press now includes detailed jacket credits on its website because readers often ask who made a particular visual element. The credits also help booksellers direct requests for permissions or interviews. They do not change ownership arrangements, which are set out in separate agreements. A printed copy of the credits appears beside the book's publication information.

passages.title: A bookseller's display idea
heading: To: Nolvari Press
From: Reni Oskel
Subject: Book display proposal
body: Our shop is planning a small display about the making of Quiet Crossings. Several customers noticed the hand-drawn title and asked how the shapes were developed. We would like to invite the person responsible for that element to explain the process in a short recorded interview. The recording would play beside the display, with headphones for visitors.

We would also like to show a sketch from the person who created the river image. A rough early version would be useful because it would let customers compare the starting point with the finished jacket. We are not asking for the author's interior photographs or the file used by the printer. Please put us in touch with the two contributors so we can discuss availability and permission directly. The display is planned for next month, but the exact opening date remains flexible. Our events assistant will handle the interview arrangements, and our display manager will take care of the physical materials.

passages.title: Finding a bicycle line's limiting stage
body: Elvori Cycles assembles each bicycle through four stages: frame preparation, wheel fitting, brake adjustment, and final inspection. A bicycle must pass through them in that order. The production team is studying the maximum number of completed bicycles the line can produce in an hour when the stages work continuously.

The slowest stage determines the line's sustained hourly capacity. Faster stages may create a temporary queue, but they cannot make completed bicycles pass through a slower stage more quickly. The study assumes that material is always available and that no bicycle needs to repeat a stage. Startup time and breaks are excluded from the comparison. The company is considering extra staffing at one stage. Its managers want to distinguish an improvement at a single workstation from an improvement in the output of the whole line. They will use the trial figures to discuss that distinction before buying equipment. The figures are intended for planning, not for evaluating individual employees' performance.

passages.title: Hourly capacity trial
body: Current capacities are frame preparation 18 bicycles, wheel fitting 12, brake adjustment 15, and final inspection 20 per hour. These values were measured over continuous runs using the same bicycle model. Each stage had the normal tools and its usual working space.

A second worker can be added to wheel fitting without changing the layout. In a separate test, that arrangement raised wheel fitting to 24 bicycles per hour. The capacities of the other three stages were not changed during that test. Observers counted bicycles only when they completed a stage. Partly finished work was recorded in a separate notebook and is not included in the hourly figures. body: For the afternoon demonstration, we will use the arrangement with the extra worker at wheel fitting. The frame, brake, and inspection teams will keep their normal arrangements. We will run long enough for the line to reach a steady flow and then count completed bicycles for one hour.

The visitors are purchasing managers from our distributors. They will stand in the marked observation area rather than walk between workstations. We have provided a printed sequence diagram, and a guide will explain the terms before the run begins. The question period will take place afterward in the sales room, where the trial figures can be displayed on a large screen.

passages.title: Continuity notes for a company film
body: The short film for Nesvori Instruments follows a customer order through four scenes. Although the story unfolds in one morning, the scenes will be filmed on different days. Objects that appear in consecutive scenes must look consistent so viewers do not notice the change in filming dates.

In Scene One, a red folder sits on the left side of the reception desk. In Scene Two, the same folder is carried into the planning room with a white label on its front. In Scene Three, a technician opens that folder in the testing room beside a blue sample case. In Scene Four, the customer receives the blue case at the dispatch counter. The folder remains with the technician.

The continuity assistant photographs the objects after each setup. These images are reference material for later filming, not publicity photographs. If a replacement object is used, the assistant must compare its visible features with the reference image before the cameras run. The director will decide whether any noticeable difference requires an earlier shot to be repeated.

passages.title: Filming allocation
body: Scene One is assigned to team Alder on Monday. Scene Two is assigned to team Birch on Wednesday. Scene Three is assigned to team Cedar on Tuesday. Scene Four is assigned to team Willow on Thursday. The dates reflect room availability, not the sequence of the story.

Each team receives only the pages relevant to its own scene. The production coordinator keeps the full sequence and distributes continuity photographs as soon as they are available. Team members should use the scene number when labeling their images rather than just the filming date.

The red folder and blue case belong to the prop department. They are checked out separately and returned at the end of each filming day. The desk and planning-room furniture remain in their normal locations. Staff working nearby have been told when the cameras will be in their rooms so they can avoid entering a shot.

passages.title: Props returned after Tuesday's filming
heading: To: Production coordinator

Subject: Returned props
body: The blue sample case came back intact. The red folder's front cover was damaged during packing, so the prop department has supplied a replacement. The replacement is the same red shade and size as the original but has no label on its front. The original photographs are in the continuity folder.

Tuesday's team finished its scene before the damage occurred. No further shots are planned with that team. Wednesday's team has collected the replacement folder, while Thursday's team has reserved the blue case. The prop department has blank white labels and can provide one if requested. Please pass these facts to the continuity assistant. The damaged cover has been kept in a separate envelope, and the undamaged contents of the folder are in the replacement. The receptionist has also confirmed that the desk will be available on Thursday. The production coordinator will circulate the next day's call sheet this afternoon.

body: 네스보리 계측기 영상은 네 장면으로 고객 주문을 따라간다. 이야기상 오전 한 번이지만 다른 날 촬영하므로 연속 장면의 물건 외관이 일치해야 한다.
장면1은 접수대 왼쪽 빨간 폴더, 장면2는 앞에 흰 라벨을 붙인 같은 폴더를 기획실로 운반, 장면3은 기술자가 시험실에서 파란 표본 케이스 옆에서 열고, 장면4는 발송 창구에서 고객에게 파란 케이스를 준다. 폴더는 기술자에게 남는다.
연결 담당자는 배치마다 사진을 찍으며 홍보용 아닌 후속 촬영 참고다. 물건을 교체하면 보이는 특징을 기준 사진과 대조한다. 차이가 있어 앞 장면을 다시 찍을지는 감독이 결정한다.

body: 장면1은 월요일 Alder팀, 장면2는 수요일 Birch팀, 장면3은 화요일 Cedar팀, 장면4는 목요일 Willow팀이다. 이야기 순서가 아니라 공간 가능 일정이다.

빨간 폴더와 파란 케이스는 소품팀 것이며 각각 대출하고 매일 반납한다. 책상과 기획실 가구는 원위치다. 주변 직원에게 촬영 시간을 알려 화면에 들어오지 않게 한다.

passages.title: Reading the hotel performance sheet
body: The management exercise at Orvani Lodging compares four hotels using occupied room-nights. One room occupied for three nights counts as three room-nights, whether one person or two people stay in it. The measure is different from the number of guests and from the number of separate bookings.

Average room revenue is calculated by dividing room revenue by occupied room-nights. For this exercise, the revenue figure excludes meals, parking, and other extras. This makes the comparison about accommodation alone. The exercise does not compare profit because operating costs have not been supplied.

All figures concern the same seven-night period. The training facilitator asks participants to calculate each property's average before discussing the results. A hotel can have the highest room revenue without having the highest average per occupied room-night. The team should explain that distinction in ordinary language when presenting the figures to colleagues outside Finance.

passages.title: Training data: four properties
body: The data sheet identifies properties by code. Occupied room-night totals have already been checked against nightly room registers. Revenue was copied from the accommodation ledger for the same dates. Both columns describe completed activity rather than future reservations.

No food or parking revenue is included. Canceled reservations are excluded because they produced no occupied room-nights in this period. The figures are complete for the seven nights and contain no estimate for later arrivals. Each property uses the same definition supplied in the exercise notice. The worksheet leaves space for participants to write the calculated average and then rank the properties. The facilitator will collect the rankings before displaying the property names. This allows participants to make their numerical comparison without relying on their previous impression of a particular hotel.

passages.title: Names for the training presentation
heading: To: Training facilitator
From: Eni Varel
Subject: Property names
body: Here is the code list for the presentation: H is the Alder Court, J is the Linden House, K is the Hazel Lodge, and M is the Aspen Inn. The names were withheld only for the first calculation round. They can appear in the discussion slides afterward.

Please open the discussion with the hotel that has the highest average room revenue per occupied room-night. Then identify the hotel with the greatest total room revenue, so participants can see whether the two measures lead to the same property. Use the accommodation-only figures on the training sheet.

The property managers will not attend the session. This is an exercise for new sales coordinators, not a ranking of manager performance. The facilitator will ask one participant to explain the room-night measure using a simple stay example. Please leave enough time for that explanation before moving on to the numerical comparison. Printed copies of the slides will be available for everyone to take away.

body: 오르바니 숙박 교육은 판매 객실박으로 네 호텔을 비교한다. 한 방3박은 투숙객1명·2명 여부와 무관하게3객실박이며 투숙객 수나 예약 건수와 다르다.
평균 객실 매출은 객실 매출을 판매 객실박으로 나눈다. 식사·주차·기타는 제외하고 숙박만 비교하며 운영비가 없어 이익 비교는 아니다.
같은7박 기간이다. 각 평균을 계산한 뒤 토론한다. 총 매출 최고 호텔이 판매 객실박당 평균도 최고인 것은 아니다. 재무 외 동료에게 이를 쉬운 말로 설명해야 한다.

passagesKo.title: 교육 자료: 네 숙소
body: 교육표는 숙소를 코드로 식별한다. 객실박은 일별 장부와 대조했고 매출은 같은 날짜의 숙박 장부에서 옮겼다. 두 열은 미래 예약 아닌 완료 실적이다.
식사·주차는 없고 실제 점유가 없는 취소 예약은 제외했다.7박의 완결 수치이며 이후 도착 예상은 없다. 모두 공지 정의를 쓴다. 평균과 순위를 쓰는 칸이 있다. 기존 호텔 인상 대신 수치로 비교하도록 진행자는 순위를 걷은 뒤 숙소 이름을 공개한다.
